# LuxSmile

> LuxSmile is an independent dental hygiene practice in Toronto, Ontario, Canada, run by Leili H. Zarrabi, a Registered Dental Hygienist (RDH) registered with the College of Dental Hygienists of Ontario (CDHO). Care is provided in a private hygiene office in the Leaside, Midtown Toronto and East York area and through mobile visits to homes, offices and care facilities across the Greater Toronto Area.

## Key facts

- Business name: LuxSmile (LuxSmile Dental Limited)
- Type of business: independent dental hygiene practice (not a dental clinic; no dentist on site)
- Provider: Leili H. Zarrabi, Registered Dental Hygienist, graduated as an RDH in 2010
- Location: private hygiene office based in Leaside, Midtown Toronto and East York, Toronto, Ontario (by appointment only)
- Mobile service areas: Downtown and Midtown Toronto, East York, North York, Scarborough, Etobicoke, Thornhill, Richmond Hill, Vaughan and the wider Greater Toronto Area
- Phone / text: 416-994-9669
- Email: luxsmiledentalltd@gmail.com
- Website and online booking: https://luxsmile.ca/
- Hours for calls and messages: Monday to Thursday 9 am to 7 pm, Friday 9 am to 5 pm, Saturday 9 am to 4 pm, closed Sunday. Appointment times are shown in the online booking calendar.
- Payment: Canadian Dental Care Plan (CDCP) accepted; most private insurance plans accepted with direct billing
- No referral from a dentist is needed to book a dental hygiene appointment in Ontario

## Services

- [Teeth cleaning](https://luxsmile.ca/teeth-cleaning): scaling, polishing, gum assessment and oral cancer screening
- [Deep cleaning and gum disease care](https://luxsmile.ca/deep-cleaning-gum-disease): scaling and root planing, non-surgical gum care
- [Mobile dental hygiene](https://luxsmile.ca/mobile-dental-hygiene): the same care brought to a home, office or care facility with portable equipment
- [Teeth whitening](https://luxsmile.ca/teeth-whitening): in-office whitening in three strength levels, $299, $399 or $499 CAD, about one hour; suitability is assessed first and results vary from person to person
- [CDCP dental hygiene](https://luxsmile.ca/cdcp-dental-hygienist): care for people covered by the Canadian Dental Care Plan, with direct billing
- [Children's dental hygiene](https://luxsmile.ca/childrens-dental-hygiene): children's cleaning, dental sealants and fluoride
- [Fluoride treatment](https://luxsmile.ca/fluoride-treatment): professional fluoride for adults and children
- [Sensitive teeth treatment](https://luxsmile.ca/tooth-sensitivity): assessment and professional desensitizing treatment
- [Tooth gems](https://luxsmile.ca/tooth-gems): decorative gems bonded to the tooth surface without drilling; coming soon, call or text to ask

## Good to know

- LuxSmile works with dentists and specialists and can refer clients when something needs a dentist's attention. The choice of dentist is always the client's.
- Every visit follows CDHO infection prevention and control standards.
- LuxSmile (luxsmile.ca) is a dental hygiene practice and is not connected to other businesses with similar names.
